name: Acqua di Gioia Eau de Parfum
editorialDescription: A fresh aquatic-floral eau de parfum from Armani Beauty, in a sea-glass green bottle with a pebble-shaped cap. Armani's own pages list primofiore lemon and mint on top, jasmine (Armani calls it water jasmine) and peony in the heart, and cedar with a brown-sugar accord in the base — fresher and less sweet than most fruity florals.
keyFeatures: Top notes: primofiore lemon, crushed mint
Base notes: cedarwood, brown sugar accord
Armani describes the base as amber-woody
advantages: Note details are published on Armani's own site
A fresh, citrus-and-mint profile that's a clear alternative to sweeter florals
disadvantages: Armani's regional sites word the notes slightly differently, so don't expect identical descriptions everywhere
suits: People who like fresh, aquatic or citrus scents
Anyone who wants a daytime fragrance that isn't fruity-sweet
skipIf: You react to fragranced products or have fragrance allergy; FDA notes fragrance ingredients may be listed only as "fragrance" on U.S. labels
You want to smell it on your own skin before committing to a full bottle; look for a travel spray, mini or sample first
buyingConsiderations: Confirm the listing is Acqua di Gioia eau de parfum (not Acqua di Giò, the men's line, or a different Acqua di Gioia version)
Prefer listings sold by the brand or Amazon
